supersedes_reason: Amendment_002 was REJECTED by independent review (4 BLOCKERS, 3 MAJORS, 2 MINORS) for diverging from the frozen executable V1 TCB ladder in five permissive ways plus one success-label remap. Amendment_002 is retained unmodified as historical evidence.
authority_precedence: 1. Frozen SHA256-pinned EXECUTABLE V1 TCB functions, where they directly define a scientific rule.
2. Frozen V2 policy artifacts (original V2 prereg, Amendment_001) where they explicitly and necessarily replace a V1 implementation detail - specifically the identifiability-conditional denominators.
3. Frozen prose (load_frozen_prereg() dicts, prereg Markdown) where no executable authority exists.
4. Explicit, prospectively-declared deterministic rules newly specified here, only where 1-3 leave a gap.
Prose may explain an executable rule but MUST NOT silently override executable semantics.

frozen_production_call_site.note: The frozen V1 arms use len(_cell_records(...)) == 400 planned worlds as their denominator ('invalid worlds stay in the denominator'). Frozen V2 authority necessarily replaces this: V2 prereg section 7 forbids planned_worlds detection denominators and section 13.3 requires conditional identifiable denominators for specificity, power, discovery, floors and materiality. Amendment_003 therefore inherits the frozen OPERATORS, THRESHOLDS and LADDER LOGIC verbatim while computing the inputs on the frozen-V2-mandated denominators. V2 prereg section 12 authorises exactly this: 'This policy unit only changes who enters those denominators and adds the coverage gate. It does not reopen those numeric detection thresholds.'

VISIBILITY_FLOOR.source_identity: load_frozen_prereg()['acceptance']['detection_floor'] and the frozen terminal branch `if visibility_wilson_upper < 0.50: return 'VISIBILITY_FLOOR'` in mechanical_conclusion() at scripts/research/harness_synthetic_edge_calibration_v1_lib.py:879; frozen production arm easy_visibility at scripts/research/harness_synthetic_edge_calibration_v1_production.py:2555 (predicate _oracle_visible / GROUND_TRUTH_VISIBLE); priority 6 of 9 in CONCLUSION_PRIORITY at scripts/research/harness_synthetic_edge_calibration_v1_lib.py:49
VISIBILITY_FLOOR.conditioning_population: WORLD_VALID worlds on EASY|5000 (baseline-level statistic; no candidate conditioning)
VISIBILITY_FLOOR.denominator_authority: Amendment_001 section 5.1 binds VISIBILITY_FLOOR to 'world baseline only (no candidate)'; V2 prereg forbids planned_worlds as a detection denominator and section 13.3 requires conditional denominators for floors; visibility failure caused by baseline non-identifiability is a world failure (V2 prereg section 3.2 note), so such worlds are WORLD_INVALID and outside world_valid_count
VISIBILITY_FLOOR.undefined_rate_behaviour: world_valid_count == 0 => undefined => cannot bind a floor; unreachable after STAGE 2 (world-baseline coverage requires Wilson lower(world_valid/planned) >= 0.95)
VISIBILITY_FLOOR.direction_of_effect_disclosure: Frozen V1 used all 400 planned cell records as this denominator; WORLD_INVALID worlds cannot be GROUND_TRUTH_VISIBLE, so excluding them RAISES the visibility rate and makes VISIBILITY_FLOOR marginally LESS likely to bind than under V1's literal arithmetic. This denominator is nevertheless mandated by frozen V2 authority (planned_worlds denominators are explicitly forbidden), and the residual gap is bounded by the STAGE 2 world-baseline coverage gate (Wilson lower >= 0.95), which V1 did not have. Disclosed rather than chosen for permissiveness.

MATERIALITY_ONLY_DIAGNOSTIC.source_identity: frozen aggregate boolean `materiality_only` at scripts/research/harness_synthetic_edge_calibration_v1_production.py:2579 (easy_strict_ex['successes'] > easy_strict['successes'] and easy_strict_ex['n'] == PRODUCTION_WORLDS_PER_CELL) supplied to mechanical_conclusion() as `materiality_only_failure`; frozen terminal branch `if materiality_only_failure: return 'MATERIALITY_ONLY_DIAGNOSTIC'` at scripts/research/harness_synthetic_edge_calibration_v1_lib.py:883; priority 8 of 9 in CONCLUSION_PRIORITY at scripts/research/harness_synthetic_edge_calibration_v1_lib.py:49; load_frozen_prereg()['acceptance']['materiality'] names the comparison
MATERIALITY_ONLY_DIAGNOSTIC.input_statistic: aggregate comparison of two ORACLE F03 gate counts on EASY|5000: STRICT_PASS_EX_MATERIALITY vs STRICT_PASS
MATERIALITY_ONLY_DIAGNOSTIC.numerator: two counts on a common denominator: successes_ex = count(oracle_F03.gates.STRICT_PASS_EX_MATERIALITY is True); successes_strict = count(oracle_F03.gates.STRICT_PASS is True)

MATERIALITY_ONLY_DIAGNOSTIC.conditioning_population: WORLD_VALID worlds on EASY|5000 in which F03 is CANDIDATE_IDENTIFIABLE
MATERIALITY_ONLY_DIAGNOSTIC.denominator_authority: V2 prereg section 13.3 lists materiality among the families computed on conditional identifiable denominators; both counts share one denominator exactly as the frozen V1 arms easy_strict_ex and easy_strict did
MATERIALITY_ONLY_DIAGNOSTIC.undefined_rate_behaviour: denominator == 0 => boolean undefined => materiality_only_failure is not evaluated; unreachable after STAGE 2
MATERIALITY_ONLY_DIAGNOSTIC.operator: materiality_only_failure := (successes_ex > successes_strict) AND (the shared denominator is complete/ADEQUATE). Strict greater-than, exactly as frozen.
MATERIALITY_ONLY_DIAGNOSTIC.equality_behaviour: successes_ex == successes_strict => materiality_only_failure is False (strict >, equality does not trigger)
MATERIALITY_ONLY_DIAGNOSTIC.frozen_completeness_leg_substitution: The frozen boolean's second leg is `easy_strict_ex['n'] == PRODUCTION_WORLDS_PER_CELL` (== 400), i.e. 'the arm's denominator is the complete planned cell'. Under V2 the denominator is the conditional identifiable count, so the literal 400 no longer applies. Amendment_003 substitutes the V2 equivalent of denominator completeness: F03 coverage ADEQUATE on EASY|5000 plus world-baseline coverage ADEQUATE, which STAGE 2 already guarantees before the ladder is entered. This substitution is equal-or-stricter: under V1 the leg was automatically satisfied on any structurally complete run, whereas the V2 coverage gate is a real additional requirement. The successes comparison itself is preserved byte-for-byte.
MATERIALITY_ONLY_DIAGNOSTIC.precedence: frozen priority 8 of 9: evaluated only if neither floor bound, and BEFORE NO_V1_EVIDENCE_OF_DISCOVERY_BOTTLENECK. When true it IS the final conclusion. Amendment_002 asserted it 'NEVER governs' and replaced the statistic with a per-world Wilson rate; BLOCKER-4 repaired here.
MATERIALITY_ONLY_DIAGNOSTIC.downstream_use: FINAL_OVERALL_MECHANICAL_CONCLUSION input `materiality_only_failure`; returns the terminal state MATERIALITY_ONLY_DIAGNOSTIC

NULL_PER_CANDIDATE_FPR.input_statistic: per-candidate NULL false-positive rate, evaluated independently for each of F01..F10 on NULL|5000
NULL_PER_CANDIDATE_FPR.numerator: candidate_detection_count[c] on NULL|5000 for the single candidate c under evaluation
NULL_PER_CANDIDATE_FPR.denominator: candidate_identifiable_count[c] on NULL|5000 for that same candidate c
NULL_PER_CANDIDATE_FPR.conditioning_population: WORLD_VALID worlds on NULL|5000 in which candidate c is CANDIDATE_IDENTIFIABLE
NULL_PER_CANDIDATE_FPR.denominator_authority: Amendment_001 section 5.1 states this id is computed 'on identifiable evaluations'; V2 prereg section 7 defines conditional_detection_rate with n = candidate_identifiable_count. CANDIDATE_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE is excluded from BOTH numerator and denominator and is never counted as a negative (non-)detection.
NULL_PER_CANDIDATE_FPR.undefined_rate_behaviour: candidate_identifiable_count[c] == 0 => undefined => cannot PASS or FAIL (V2 prereg section 7); the diagnostic is NOT_CLAIMABLE for that candidate
NULL_PER_CANDIDATE_FPR.operator: PASS iff wilson_upper <= threshold; FAIL iff wilson_lower > threshold; otherwise INDETERMINATE
NULL_PER_CANDIDATE_FPR.equality_behaviour: wilson_upper == threshold => PASS; wilson_lower == threshold => INDETERMINATE (not FAIL)

candidates: the single candidate c under evaluation

coverage_prerequisite.disclosed_conflict: MAJOR-1: the two frozen authorities above disagree on the required candidate scope for this id. Amendment_003 honours BOTH by splitting the roles (see resolution).
coverage_prerequisite.resolution: A single candidate's per-candidate FPR may be COMPUTED AND REPORTED as a diagnostic when that candidate alone is ADEQUATE (Amendment_001 section 5.2). The canonical conclusion id NULL_PER_CANDIDATE_FPR, in its role as a pre-ladder claimability gate and as a component of NULL_FALSE_POSITIVE_CONCLUSION, is claimable only when the complete frozen required-coverage map for F01..F10 on NULL|5000 is satisfied (frozen_required_coverage_map). Fail-closed: the stricter authority governs the governing use; the looser authority governs only the reported diagnostic.

NULL_PER_CANDIDATE_FPR.precedence: Evaluated at STAGE 2b, AFTER STAGE 2 coverage and BEFORE the inherited frozen ladder (STAGE 3). It can only add a refusal; it can never convert an inherited failure into success. Any FAIL yields the frozen specificity consequence METHODOLOGY_REPAIR_REQUIRED_BEFORE_B2_06; any INDETERMINATE yields CALIBRATION_INDETERMINATE. It is deliberately NOT injected into the frozen ladder's own verdict tuple, so the inherited ladder remains bit-exact against frozen mechanical_conclusion().
NULL_PER_CANDIDATE_FPR.downstream_use: FINAL_OVERALL_MECHANICAL_CONCLUSION STAGE 2b gate (aggregated over all ten candidates via NOT_CLAIMABLE > FAIL > INDETERMINATE > PASS); component of NULL_FALSE_POSITIVE_CONCLUSION

NULL_FALSE_POSITIVE_CONCLUSION.source_identity: Amendment_001 section 5.1 ('union of NULL oracle FPR, per-candidate FPR, and BLIND FPR') and section 5.2 ('the bundled NULL_FALSE_POSITIVE_CONCLUSION still requires all ten'); the exact combination operator is newly specified here
NULL_FALSE_POSITIVE_CONCLUSION.input_statistic: composite of NULL_ORACLE_FPR, NULL_BLIND_FPR and the ten NULL_PER_CANDIDATE_FPR(c) verdicts
NULL_FALSE_POSITIVE_CONCLUSION.denominator: not applicable (composite of verdicts, not a rate)
NULL_FALSE_POSITIVE_CONCLUSION.conditioning_population: the union of its components' conditioning populations; each component keeps its own denominator
NULL_FALSE_POSITIVE_CONCLUSION.denominator_authority: components carry their own pinned denominators
NULL_FALSE_POSITIVE_CONCLUSION.undefined_rate_behaviour: if any component is undefined/NOT_CLAIMABLE the composite is NOT_CLAIMABLE
NULL_FALSE_POSITIVE_CONCLUSION.operator: components = [NULL_ORACLE_FPR, NULL_BLIND_FPR] + [NULL_PER_CANDIDATE_FPR(c) for c in F01..F10]; NOT_CLAIMABLE if any component is NOT_CLAIMABLE; else FAIL if any is FAIL; else INDETERMINATE if any is INDETERMINATE; else PASS
NULL_FALSE_POSITIVE_CONCLUSION.equality_behaviour: inherited from each component's own equality behaviour
NULL_FALSE_POSITIVE_CONCLUSION.precedence: NOT_CLAIMABLE > FAIL > INDETERMINATE > PASS. Reported as the bundled NULL specificity statement. It is NOT an input to the frozen ladder: the ladder consumes oracle_null_specificity and blind_null_specificity individually (frozen production call site) and the per-candidate component acts at STAGE 2b. Amendment_002 substituted this composite for the frozen ladder's individual inputs, which is how trap_specificity came to be dropped.
